lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgSiO₃ (Mg₄Si₄O₁₂ per cell) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmcm (No. 63), with 20 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Mg centers as octahedral, each coordinated by six O neighbors, while Si centers show fourfold O coordination; O centers have two geometric neighbors, one Mg and one Si. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include edge-sharing between Mg octahedra, with additional corner-sharing between Mg octahedra and Si four-vertex polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites.
